about: Gravita India Limited manufactures and recycles lead metal, lead products, aluminium alloys, and plastic granules in India and internationally. It operates through Lead Processing, Aluminium Processing, Turn-Key Solutions, Plastic Manufacturing, and Copper Alloys and Strips Processing segments. The company engages in smelting of lead battery scrap/lead concentrate to produce secondary lead metal, such as pure lead, specific lead alloy, lead oxides, and lead sheets, lead powder, lead shot, etc.;
